alex: hi team :wave: first day here. i need staging console access + a service account for running our e2e tests. who should i ping?
jen: welcome alex!! :tada: @infra is the right team. please fill out the access form (https://redwood.internal/onboard-access) and cc me. include the project id and a short reason.
infra-bot: New access request ticket created: INC-48291 — assigned to infra-onboard queue. Estimated response <= 8h.
samir: hey alex — cc’d. quick checklist to speed things up:
1) request staging Console role: "console.viewer" + service account usage
2) request a service account with roles: logging.writer, storage.objectViewer, inference-service-user
3) request the key be stored at vault path: secret/data/onboard/alex
If you want to create a service account locally for testing, you can run (example):
```bash
gcloud iam service-accounts create alex-onboard --display-name="alex onboard"
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-staging --member="serviceAccount:alex-onboard@redwood-staging.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --role="roles/logging.writer"
```
alex: thanks! tried the form link but got a 403 in the UI: "403: user not allowed to create request". attaching screenshot.
samir: hmm. what's your SSO groups? run `id` or check your Okta profile. Could be you weren't added to the console-onboard group yet. I can escalate if needed.
alex: ok my SSO groups show: engineers only.
jen: that’s the issue — people-ops should auto-add new hires to `console-onboard`. @micaela can you confirm provisioning?
micaela: been swamped but i can add them manually. adding alex to console-onboard now.
micaela: done — group membership updated. should propagate in ~5 min. try the form again after a couple minutes.
alex: form works now, submitted request and included the project id + test description. ticket INC-48291 updated with form link.
samir: perfect. i'll start the service account provisioning and push keys to the vault path. expect a vault secret created by EOD; i'll post the secret path here when it's ready. if you need a very short-lived API key for local dev right away i can create one with a 12h TTL — lmk.
alex: appreciate it :thumbsup: that would help for running the first CI jobs locally.
jen: welcome aboard again! check the onboarding quickstart: https://redwood.internal/docs/onboarding/console-quickstart and DM me if anything blocks you today.
alex: thanks all — excited to be here :smile:
